name: Browser and Playwright
summary: Browser automation capability for local UI inspection, screenshots, interaction checks, and E2E-style validation when a ticket requires it.

source.notes: Registered for validation and inspection. PIP-153 does not add browser tests or install packages.

useWhen: A frontend, local web app, or UI workflow ticket needs visual or interaction validation.
A ticket asks for screenshots, browser navigation, or E2E-style evidence.
doNotUseWhen: The ticket has no UI/browser surface.
The task requires authenticated production/customer data or external accounts without approval.
routing.fallback: Use static review and local test commands, and record that browser validation was not applicable or unavailable.

inputs.name: targetUrlOrApp
inputs.description: Local URL, file, or application target to inspect.

outputs.name: uiValidationEvidence
outputs.description: Screenshot, interaction result, console observation, or E2E-style validation note.

schemas.notes: Future observability work may normalize UI validation evidence.

forbiddenOperations: Submit forms to real external systems without approval

cost.costDriver: Local validation only unless external browser services are introduced.

risks.description: Screenshots or browser sessions can reveal private data.
risks.mitigation: Use local/test data only and avoid authenticated private or production contexts unless approved.

governance.dataBoundary: Prefer local fixtures and non-sensitive test data.
governance.sensitiveActionBoundary: Do not interact with production, payment, customer, or external communication flows without approval.
governance.loggingRequirement: Record target, validation result, and whether screenshots or browser checks were used.
governance.updatePolicy: Update when UI validation workflow or browser tooling changes.

review.reviewNotes: Pilot validation capability; safe by default only for local non-sensitive targets.

examples.scenario: A frontend PR changes a local app screen.
examples.expectedUse: Use browser automation to inspect layout and interaction on local targets.
examples.expectedNonUse: Do not browse authenticated production systems or expose private data.
